newsitem.title: USA: NAPM sees moderate manufacturing growth in 1997.
newsitem.headline: NAPM sees moderate manufacturing growth in 1997.

text.p: The nation's manufacturers expect moderate growth in 1997 with slightly lower material costs and slightly higher labor costs, according to the National Association of Purchasing Management.

In its semiannual forecast, NAPM members said they expect 5.4 percent revenue growth on average in 1997 with a 0.5 percent drop in prices paid for materials in the first four months of 1997. The report also predicts prices overall to remain unchanged in 1997, while labor and benefit costs will increase by 2.8 percent in 1997.
